E4201

TLS handshake with `{host}` failed.

What

TLS handshake with `{host}` failed.

Why

The URL reached a server, but the connection did not complete a secure HTTPS handshake. The usual cause is pointing an `https://` URL at a plain HTTP server or a server with a broken TLS setup.

Fix

Verify the URL points at an HTTPS server, not plain HTTP. For local tests, start the TLS fixture server.
